rules.data: same verified cached seven-stock EXCHANGE15m 17:45 base18 features; exact18open->nextcalendar10open net target
rules.diagnostics: baseline,quarters,omittedquarters,best1/3positivePnLdates omitted IN HINDSIGHT using frozen robustness review; not a tradable filter

rules.folds: unchanged chronological2018+train/calibration/test2024/25/partial26; purge label_end at boundaries; no shuffle split
rules.mlp: 18->16->8->1 tanh,200iterations,noearlystop; median of all3 fixed seeds; no winning seed selection
rules.policy: predictednet>.10pct, identical decisions in ordinary/stress accounts; no profit probabilities or new filters
rules.preprocessing: train-only weighted StandardScaler, featureclip+-8; original prices/labels never enter inference
rules.reuse: all evaluated years previously viewed, exploratory not untouched holdout; no multiple-search correction or confidence-of-profit claim
rules.screen: 2025AND2026 each>=20candidate_dates,complete baseline and >0 baseline/dropbest1/dropbest3 at BOTH costlevels; all3years flag additionally requires2024 same
rules.warnings: finite models retained with convergence/iteration warnings disclosed; no refits or dropped poor variants
rules.weights: each known training date equal total weight; weight per row=(n/dates)/stocks_that_date; fit-only
